header.name: CMS8S78xx SystemClock P3.2 blink liveness proof

steps.description: P3.2 software-delay blink indicator shows toggle activity (liveness only, never absolute period: the Keil for(3000) delay loop is pure arithmetic and charges ~0 virtual time per ADR-0076 native-backend limits, so the 50kHz sim pacing is NOT the silicon blink rate). Separate file from clo.scenario.json: the headless getPinEdges feed is pin-agnostic, so mixed-pin waveforms would corrupt each other's counts.
